MUST also collect judge response generations (--generate-judge-responses) for UDA baseline compatibility.\", \"status\": \"RUNNING\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-002\", \"name\": \"item_exposure_estimation\", \"claim\": 2, \"description\": \"Estimate per-item exposure e_i via three-source pipeline: (1) Primary: item-level performance gap between original items and GPT-5.5/Claude-rephrased reference variants, averaged across reference models, with spline difficulty correction (ConStat-inspired). (2) Temporal: performance gap on pre-cutoff vs post-cutoff item variants where available. (3) LogProber: token logprob memorization scores for models with logprob API. Sources combined via weighted composite (weights tuned on validation split). ConStat per-model delta used as external validation of fitted c_n, not as e_i source.\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 30, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\"], \"notes\": \"Main bottleneck: reference benchmark variant construction + quality validation. ConStat per-model delta validates G-MFRM c_n, not used for per-item e_i.\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-003\", \"name\": \"gmfrm_real_data_fit\", \"claim\": [1, 2, 3], \"description\": \"Fit G-MFRM three-stage pipeline on real data from exp-001/002. Stage 1: MFRM (θ,b,d). Stage 2: e_i from exp-002. Stage 3: Joint gated model. Compare fair scores θ̂ with Chatbot Arena human votes (Kendall-τ).\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 15, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\", \"exp-002\"], \"notes\": \"NumPyro MCMC. Use MVP MCMC settings (warmup=2000, samples=4000, chains=4, NCP, target_accept=0.95). Include per-benchmark analysis: if any benchmark has contamination ≈ 0, verify G-MFRM degrades gracefully to MFRM level (real-data graceful degradation check).\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-004\", \"name\": \"baseline_comparison\", \"claim\": 3, \"description\": \"Compare G-MFRM against 8 baselines on same data: (1) raw multi-judge average, (2) MFRM-only, (3) sequential pipeline, (4) CyclicJudge, (5) CyclicJudge + contaminated item discard, (6) DCR Factor, (7) UDA, (8) Preference Leakage calibration. Metrics: Kendall-τ, Spearman-ρ with Chatbot Arena. MUST include rank change analysis: show which specific models change rank, by how many positions, and top-k stability (k=5,10).\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 20, \"deps\": [\"exp-003\"], \"notes\": \"Baseline (5) is the strongest trivial alternative — addresses Reviewer Concern #1. CyclicJudge/UDA/DCR/PrefLeakage need public code check. Budget may not include debug time. Rank change analysis addresses Dream R2-W3. MUST include post-hoc power analysis: compute statistical power for Wilcoxon test to detect observed Δτ at α=0.05 with N models. If power < 0.80, discuss implications and consider increasing items/judges.\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-005\", \"name\": \"contamination_magnitude_calibration\", \"claim\": 1, \"description\": \"Estimate real contamination magnitude: compare fitted c_n from exp-003 with synthetic MVP assumptions. Determine if real contamination is closer to mvp_001 (c~0.5, weak) or mvp_002 (c~1.5, strong). Critical for claim strength.\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 5, \"deps\": [\"exp-003\"], \"notes\": \"Reviewer flagged: if real c ≈ mvp_001 level, paper impact weakens. This experiment determines claim calibration.\", \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-006\", \"name\": \"judge_count_sensitivity\", \"claim\": 2, \"description\": \"Sensitivity analysis: vary number of judges (2, 4, 6, 8+) and measure G-MFRM performance degradation. At what minimum judge count does G-MFRM still outperform sequential? Include leave-one-judge-out residual diagnostic: check if removing a judge that shares model family with targets systematically changes residuals (preference leakage detection).\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 10, \"deps\": [\"exp-003\"], \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-007\", \"name\": \"exposure_indicator_ablation\", \"claim\": 2, \"description\": \"Ablation: contribution of each exposure indicator (ConStat delta, temporal signal, LogProber Safe Score) to e_i estimation quality. Leave-one-out analysis.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 10, \"deps\": [\"exp-002\", \"exp-003\"], \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-008\", \"name\": \"facet_fit_diagnostics\", \"claim\": 2, \"description\": \"Measurement quality validation: report infit/outfit MNSQ for all facets (θ, b, d, c). Flag misfitting elements. Compare Stage 1 person-fit (lz, EMRi) vs Stage 3 c_n as construct coherence validation. MUST also report: divergent transition count, posterior predictive check, trace plots for key parameters.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 5, \"deps\": [\"exp-003\"], \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-009\", \"name\": \"confounding_formal_observation\", \"registry_id\": \"exp-009\", \"claim\": 1, \"description\": \"Formal bias analysis: derive first-order bias approximation for sequential estimator under d_j/c_n·e_i non-orthogonality. Validate via Monte Carlo simulation across realistic parameter ranges. For paper Section 2. Frame as 'Observation' (standard OVB from Angrist & Pischke 2009), not 'Proposition'. MUST include synthetic c_n point-estimate validation: generate data with known ground-truth c_n, fit G-MFRM, report per-model c_n RMSE and 95% credible interval coverage probability.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 10, \"deps\": [], \"notes\": \"Can run in parallel with data collection. Extends MVP synthetic analysis. Downgraded from 'Proposition' to 'Observation' per Dream review. Synthetic c_n validation addresses Dream R1-N3.\", \"status\": \"RUNNING\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-012\", \"name\": \"error_propagation_sensitivity\", \"registry_id\": \"exp-012\", \"claim\": 2, \"description\": \"Sensitivity analysis for staged estimation: inject Gaussian noise into e_i estimates at σ=0.1,0.2,0.5 before Stage 3 fitting. Measure θ̂ RMSE degradation and c_n recovery accuracy. Shows three-stage pipeline is robust to e_i estimation error. Use synthetic data with known ground truth.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 5, \"deps\": [], \"notes\": \"Addresses Dream R2-W5 and R1-N1. Can run on MVP codebase with modifications. Critical for defending staged estimation design choice.\", \"status\": \"DONE\", \"conclusion\": \"success\", \"metrics\": {\"verdict\": \"PARTIAL (σ≤0.2 robust, σ=0.5 exceeds threshold)\", \"false_failure\": true, \"false_failure_reason\": \"EXIT_CODE=129 (SIGHUP) after all 80/80 fits completed and results saved\", \"sigma_0.0\": {\"theta_rmse\": 0.1277, \"theta_rmse_std\": 0.0178, \"theta_tau\": 0.9159, \"cn_rmse\": 0.533, \"cn_corr\": 0.8599, \"rhat_max\": 1.02, \"ess_min\": 276, \"n\": 20}, \"sigma_0.1\": {\"theta_rmse\": 0.1295, \"theta_rmse_std\": 0.0178, \"theta_tau\": 0.9153, \"cn_rmse\": 0.5452, \"cn_corr\": 0.8542, \"delta_theta_pct\": 1.4, \"delta_cn_pct\": 2.3}, \"sigma_0.2\": {\"theta_rmse\": 0.1352, \"theta_rmse_std\": 0.0175, \"theta_tau\": 0.914, \"cn_rmse\": 0.5751, \"cn_corr\": 0.8385, \"delta_theta_pct\": 5.9, \"delta_cn_pct\": 7.9}, \"sigma_0.5\": {\"theta_rmse\": 0.1748, \"theta_rmse_std\": 0.0266, \"theta_tau\": 0.885, \"cn_rmse\": 0.8415, \"cn_corr\": 0.745, \"delta_theta_pct\": 36.9, \"delta_cn_pct\": 57.9}, \"convergence\": {\"all_rhat_max\": 1.02, \"pass\": true}, \"total_runtime_seconds\": 14585, \"artifacts\": [\"error_propagation.png\", \"cn_degradation.png\", \"summary.csv\"]}}, {\"id\": \"exp-010\", \"name\": \"wildbench_replication\", \"claim\": 3, \"description\": \"Replicate G-MFRM pipeline on WildBench as third benchmark. Cross-benchmark generalization.\", \"priority\": \"P2\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 40, \"deps\": [\"exp-003\"], \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-011\", \"name\": \"adversarial_robustness\", \"claim\": 2, \"description\": \"Test G-MFRM robustness against adversarial contamination following Wang et al. (ICLR 2026) fragility findings.\", \"priority\": \"P2\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 15, \"deps\": [\"exp-003\"], \"status\": \"planned\"}], \"total\": 12}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {}}"}

## 任务：适配 DCR Factor baseline 到 exp-001 数据格式

**背景**: DCR Factor (EMNLP 2025) 是我们论文 exp-004 baseline comparison 中的 "contamination-only correction" baseline。公开 repo: github.com/chengxuphd/dcr, Apache-2.0。

### 目标
1. 理解 DCR Factor 代码的输入输出格式
2. 编写适配层：exp-001 judge evaluation JSONL → DCR Factor 输入
3. 确保 exp-004 可以直接调用

### Phase 1: 获取并理解 DCR Factor 代码（ssh_execute + ssh_read_only）

```bash
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

cd /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias
git clone https://github.com/chengxuphd/dcr.git baselines/dcr_factor 2>/dev/null || echo "Already cloned"

# 查看代码结构
ls -la baselines/dcr_factor/
find baselines/dcr_factor -name "*.py" | head -20

# 读核心代码
cat baselines/dcr_factor/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -80
```

重点关注：
- `DCRCalculator.calculate_dcr(s1, s2, s3, s4)` 的输入格式（4 层污染分数）
- 输入数据结构：每个 model × benchmark 的 4 层分数如何计算
- 输出：DCR Factor [0,1] 的含义和用法

### Phase 2: 理解数据映射需求（ssh_read_only）

```bash

head -5 /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001/results/gpt-5.5-proxy/arena_hard_judgments.jsonl 2>/dev/null
```

需要理解：
- 我们的 JSONL 包含哪些字段
- DCR Factor 需要的 4 层分数 (Semantic/Information/Data/Label contamination) 如何从我们的数据推导
- 如果某些分数无法直接计算，需要什么额外信息

### Phase 3: 编写适配代码（ssh_execute）

创建 `/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/baselines/dcr_adapter.py`

```python
"""
DCR Factor baseline adapter for G-MFRM project.

Adapts exp-001 multi-judge evaluation data to DCR Factor input format.
DCR Factor computes a contamination score per model×benchmark pair.

Input: exp-001 judge evaluation JSONL files
Output: DCR Factor scores per model, usable as baseline in exp-004

Reference: Cheng et al. (EMNLP 2025) "DCR: Data Contamination Report"
"""
```

1. 读取 exp-001 的 judge evaluation 结果
2. 计算或映射 4 层污染分数（如果不能完全映射，说明哪些需要额外数据）
3. 调用 DCR Calculator
4. 输出 per-model DCR Factor
5. 提供与 G-MFRM 结果对比的接口

```bash

python3 -c "import py_compile; py_compile.compile('/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/baselines/dcr_adapter.py', doraise=True)" && echo "OK"

# 如果可能，用现有数据做一个 dry-run

```

1. DCR Factor 核心逻辑总结（4 层分数含义 + 计算方式）

4. 如果有不可映射的部分，建议替代方案
5. 与 exp-004 baseline comparison 的集成建议
